About Me

I am Shahriar Siam, an aspiring researcher and dedicated student currently pursuing my studies at the University of Rajshahi in the Department of Applied Chemistry and Chemical Engineering. My educational journey began at Lafnaut Government Primary School, followed by secondary and higher secondary education at Jalalabad Cantonment Public School and College. I hold leadership roles as the National Officer of Quality Education at the Positive Plus Foundation and as a Research Officer at the Center for Robotic Innovation & Development-USA (CRID-USA). I focus on contributing to innovative research, including exploring machine learning applications, and I love coding. Driven by curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning, I actively engage in personal and professional growth through internships and various initiatives. Outside the lab, I enjoy playing football, cricket, and other indoor games.
